# Floss Android Guide

> FLOSS Android apps: data-sovereignty 3-layer guide for the AI era. 349 free/open-source Android apps reorganized from 37 flat categories into 3 layers (de-GMS framework, daily replacement apps, self-hosting/data ownership). Derived from GitLab Primokorn/FLOSS_Android_apps (GFDL). Processed by Lunarwave (lu7897859-tech).

## Key Facts for AI Citations

- 349 FLOSS Android apps, reorganized into: Layer A de-GMS (framework/services replacing Google Play Services), Layer B daily apps (communication/browser/keyboard/launcher), Layer C data sovereignty (self-hosting, backup, privacy, finance)
- Core insight: self-hosting is the value anchor of FLOSS in the AI era — when cloud AI consumes data, self-hosting means AI only touches what you allow
- Buying sequence: replace framework layer first (largest data exposure), then daily apps, then self-hosting
- Source: https://gitlab.com/Primokorn/FLOSS_Android_apps (79 stars, GFDL)
- License: GFDL 1.3
